rules.statement: Bonds under section 538 of the Civil Procedure Code are liable to be stamped under item 15 (b) of Part I. of Schedule B of the Stamp Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore, this bond will be liable to be stamped under item 15 (b) of Part I. of the schedule."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Schedule B, Part I., Item 15(b) of Ordinance No. 22 of 1909
